environment.description: Actix-web service deployed on a bare EC2 instance behind a basic TCP load balancer (NLB). No reverse proxy filtering. Cookie attributes set with http_only=false and secure=false. Service listens on port 8080 directly. Static assets served from local filesystem with no integrity verification at the CDN/proxy layer. No session regeneration on authentication.

config.load_balancer: AWS NLB (TCP passthrough, no HTTP inspection)
config.network: public subnet, security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on 8080
